title: A gate whose question names a model usage field (cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens) or a token-count function is classed secrets since the closed code-parts list
goal: a gate naming cache_read_input_tokens or cache_creation_input_tokens as an identifier is classed by its other words, while registration_token, vault_token and my_token stay secrets

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_authority as b; c=b.class_reasons({"touches":[]},{"id":"g1","question":"Why does cache_read_input_tokens differ?","options":["one","two"]})[0]; print("class",c); sys.exit(0 if c=="design" else 1)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_authority as b; c=lambda w: b.class_reasons({'touches':[]},{'id':'g1','question':'Why does '+w+' differ?','options':['one','two']})[0]; bad=[w for w in ('cache_read_input_tokens','cache_creation_input_tokens') if c(w)!='design']+[w for w in ('registration_token','vault_token','my_token') if c(w)!='secrets']; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
